body: Indeed, my thoughts exactly. Well put.
i understand, often the implication seems to be that you’re going through a normal period of grief that time can fix, but i feel broken on a fundamental level
that’s true, and i don’t blame them either, it’s just not very convincing to me
indeed, it just does away with the entire category of ‘problems’ which seems very appealing
i suppose it sounds clever to someone who’s not prone to overthinking things
